scope.broadContactSheetSampling: For 95 higher-risk IDs containing flag, pullup, pushup, bridge, neck, chin, or Pilates, sheets show start, midpoint, and final frozen frame.
scope.denseContactSheetSampling: For 16 neck/chin/Pilates/flag-support candidates, sheets show eight evenly spaced unique frames excluding the duplicated loop endpoint.
scope.imageAppearance: Frozen rendered frames were alpha-composited on white and resized using the same Pillow path as tools/blender/encode.py. Inputs were read only.
limitations: Contact sheets are visual triage; they do not replace watching each full movie or deciding exercise inclusion.
